deployments 面闭环：`checkoutservice 0/1 READY, AVAILABLE 0`；endpoints 面 `checkoutservice` **无任何后端地址**（对比其余服务均有端点）→ 业务服务可达性中断成立。`GetAlerts()` 无指标异常（无 CPU/内存/网络类指针），排除资源与网络延迟类。

Failed to pull image "ghcr.io/google-samples/microservices-demo/checkoutservice:v0.10.3":

unexpected status from GET request to https://ghcr.io/token?scope=...: 403 Forbidden

```

| 服务 | image |
|---|---|
| frontend / paymentservice（健康，Running） | `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/<svc>:v0.10.3` |
| **checkoutservice（故障）** | **`ghcr.io/google-samples/microservices-demo/checkoutservice:v0.10.3`** |
